fields.label: Enable My Work
fields.description: When unchecked, My Work switches off: the dashboard and workspace are hidden and no notifications are sent. My Work never changes ERPNext permissions; it only displays existing To-Dos, Tasks and workflow approvals.

fields.label: Enable Automatic Notifications
fields.description: Send a daily overdue summary to each person with overdue items. Only the person themselves is notified. Notifications appear under the bell icon; whether they are also emailed follows each user's own Notification Settings.

fields.label: Send At
fields.description: Server time. Sent once a day, within 5 minutes of this time. If you turn notifications on after today's send time has passed, today's summary goes out within 5 minutes.

fields.label: Skip People on Holiday
fields.description: Before sending, check each person's Holiday List (from their Employee record, or their company's default). Nobody is notified on a day that is a holiday or weekly off in their list. People with no Employee record or no holiday list are still notified.
